notes.title: v1.53 Corrections in English translations
notes.content:
The following have been fixed in version 1.53:

[list]
[*] The English save and load screen now displays information correctly.
[*] Some text in Chapter 4 was not translated into English, but it has now been translated.
[*] English translation improvements have been made throughout the game.
[/list]

If you see any errors or issues, please let us know here. If they are translation issues, please tell us the exact phrase so we can fix it immediately.

Thank you!

notes.title: Remembering Emily is now available!
notes.content: [p]When we started creating Tortita Studio, we saw the launch of our first game, Remembering Emily, as far away as we could see.[/p][p]Today, August 13th, we can finally share with you all the hard work of the past few months.[/p][p]We hope to learn from all of you, listening to both suggestions for future stories and improvements we can make to this one. What's more, we've already noted some suggestions from some content creators and Steam curators that we want to implement in this and future Visual Novels we publish.[/p][p]Once again, thank you for wanting to play our first Visual Novel, and we hope this is the first of many stories to tell you all.[/p]

notes.title: Video drawing Remembering Emily and a reflection
notes.content: [p]After months of working on our first Visual Novel, Remembering Emily, knowing that it will be available on Steam on August 13th... fills us with pride.[/p][p]Tortita Studio is a two-person team: an illustrator and a writer/programmer. We came together to create the kind of Visual Novels we love to play the most. Stories of mystery and intrigue that you can play in 3-4 hours and leave feeling good afterward.[/p][p]We hope you like our first work as Tortita Studio, and we promise to listen to your feedback to continue working on future Visual Novels, which are already in pre-production.[/p][p]Thank you![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="5PHXggH8u9w;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: "Remembering Emily" has completed development and is ready for release!
notes.content:
[p]After a lot of effort and hard work by a very small team (illustrator, programmer/writer, and the English translator of the title), we can proudly say that the game has been completed.[/p][p][/p][p]We are now getting everything ready for the release, fixing tiny bugs in the game (the illustrator keeps wanting to change things 😆) and preparing our promotional efforts.[/p][p][/p][p]As passionate fans of Visual Novels, releasing our first title is a huge milestone, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed developing it.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are some images we've already revealed on the game's page.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602865/c1ba49404946ac404d615a1f4f5a539282eecb4c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602865/f65ac3168fc262549ff4dabebb637dfdcd942136.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602865/1104994ef4c6d3620000137bef24c287144ddbcb.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602865/dd840636d3996094d5debb167dfedd4cbda98c54.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602865/08a628d3be462113a9499204cd40078b7681a849.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602865/1f597163d2093c85ff3e6165d30b5a14c5020814.png"][/img][/p]

notes.content:
